responses.raw:
VERDICT: VALID
REASON: "avions évité" is grammatically correct. This is the plus-que-parfait (pluperfect) tense of the verb "éviter" (to avoid) with "nous" as the subject. After "Si seulement" (if only) when expressing regret about a past event, French uses the plus-que-parfait: "nous avions évité" (we had avoided). The complete sentence "Si seulement nous avions évité cette querelle stupide à l'époque !" is a correct construction for expressing a wish that something in the past had been different.
